none: PAS NLM-7DA8E8: Roman Coin: Dupondius of Trajan
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP CAES NER TRAIANO OPTIMO AVG GER DAC PM TRP COS VI PP ; R/ SENATVS POPVLUSQUE ROMANVS

Copper alloy coin. Dupondius of Trajan (98-117), mint of Rome issue of 114-117, RIC volume 2 no. 674. Obverse description: Radiate bust draped right, long neck. Obverse inscription: IMP CAES NER TRAIANO OPTIMO AVG GER DAC PM TRP COS VI PP. Reverse description: Felicitas standing left with cornucopiae and caduceus/wand; SC in field. Reverse inscription: SENATVS POPVLUSQUE ROMANVS. Diameter: 27.5mm, Weight: 12.33gms, die axis: 6
